nodes.title: SG-1 Stop tracking node_modules and dist
nodes.body:
Context: game/frontend/node_modules (13,601 files) and game/frontend/dist (4 files: index.html, assets/bedroom.svg, one css, one js) are still tracked by git. The root .gitignore ignores node_modules/ but has no dist/ rule. The repo already has npm run untrack:node-modules (game/frontend/scripts/untrackNodeModules.ts calling untrackNodeModules in src/lib/trackedNodeModules.ts), the guard script assertNoTrackedNodeModules.ts, and tests for both. Desired behavior: dist is ignored and untracked through the same tooling, and the guard tests assert it. Expected result: no file under node_modules or dist is tracked and no source file in game/src or game/frontend/src outside the helpers changes. Why: repo hygiene, first step of the refactor.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the root .gitignore, when dist/ is checked with isIgnoredByDirRule for game/frontend/dist/index.html, then it is ignored
- Given the untrack tooling is run, when git ls-files is listed for game/frontend/dist and game/frontend/node_modules, then both are empty
- Given a git listing that contains a dist path, when checkTrackedFiles runs, then the dist path is reported and the guard returns 1
- Given the work is done, when npm test and npm run typecheck run in game/ and game/frontend/, then both pass with no test deleted or skipped


## Scope
- In scope: Add dist/ to root .gitignore
- In scope: Extend src/lib/trackedNodeModules.ts untrack and guard logic to cover dist
- In scope: Run the existing npm run untrack:node-modules
- In scope: Extend existing guard tests
- Out of scope: Any change in game/src
- Out of scope: Any change in game/frontend/src outside src/lib helpers
- Out of scope: Rewriting untrackNodeModules.ts script
- Out of scope: Phaser upgrade, backend/
- Preserve: Phaser pinned at ~3.90.0 and phaser-pin guard test
- Preserve: Gameplay unchanged
- Preserve: Existing guard tests keep passing


## Technical constraints
- Reuse npm run untrack:node-modules; do not rewrite it
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0
- npm test and npm run typecheck pass in game/ and game/frontend/
- No test deleted or skipped; no source file over 200 lines
- game/src never imports from game/frontend; Zustand store sole GameState owner
- backend/ and frontend/src/api/client.ts out of scope
- No change to what the player sees or can do
- Tests mock only what is external


## Definition of done
- All requirements delivered with Act and Verify units green
- node_modules and dist untracked


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.body:

- Every step lands green

nodes.title: REQ · Existing untrack logic also untracks dist and the index is cleaned
nodes.body:
Context: untrackNodeModules in game/frontend/src/lib/trackedNodeModules.ts only runs git rm --cached for node_modules. Desired behavior: it also untracks dist with a cached-only recursive rm, and running npm run untrack:node-modules leaves none of the 4 dist files or 13,601 node_modules files tracked. Expected result: git ls-files shows nothing under game/frontend/dist or node_modules. Why: acceptance of SG-1.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a fake git runner, when untrackNodeModules runs, then one call is rm -r --cached --ignore-unmatch -q -- dist
- Given a fake git runner, when untrackNodeModules runs, then every call carries --cached
- Given the script has been run, when git ls-files lists dist and node_modules under game/frontend, then output is empty


## Scope
- In scope: untrackNodeModules in src/lib/trackedNodeModules.ts
- In scope: Running the existing npm script once
- Out of scope: Changing scripts/untrackNodeModules.ts
- Preserve: Existing node_modules and results.json untrack calls
- Preserve: Working-tree files stay on disk


## Technical constraints
- Reuse the existing script, no rewrite
- Only --cached removals so files stay on disk
- Tests mock only git (fake runner)


## Definition of done
- dist untrack call added
- Script executed and index clean


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Tracked-files guard reports tracked dist paths and fails npm test
nodes.body:
Context: checkTrackedFiles returns tracked node_modules and vitest-cache paths; runGuard in scripts/assertNoTrackedNodeModules.ts returns 1 when any are found and runs before vitest via npm test. Desired behavior: tracked paths with a dist segment are reported too, so the guard fails while dist is tracked. Expected result: runGuard returns 1 and logs game/frontend/dist/index.html when listed. Why: keep dist from being re-tracked.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given trackedDistPaths input containing game/frontend/dist/index.html and src/a.ts, when called, then only the dist path is returned
- Given ls-files output with a dist file, when checkTrackedFiles runs, then it includes that file once
- Given ls-files output with a dist file, when runGuard runs, then it returns 1 and logs the path
- Given only source files, when runGuard runs, then it returns 0


## Scope
- In scope: New trackedDistPaths helper and checkTrackedFiles in src/lib/trackedNodeModules.ts
- In scope: Comment in assertNoTrackedNodeModules.ts
- Out of scope: Changing npm test chain
- Preserve: node_modules and vitest cache reporting
- Preserve: Look-alike names such as distance or dist.ts are not matched


## Technical constraints
- Match a whole path segment named dist
- Tests use a fake git runner only


## Definition of done
- Guard reports dist
- Existing guard tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

steps.expected: All four tests in the file pass
